```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

O = Path("../analysis/outputs")

def records(df, dcol, vcol):
    df = df[[dcol, vcol]].dropna().copy()
    df[dcol] = pd.to_datetime(df[dcol]).dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    df = df.rename(columns={dcol: "date", vcol: "value"}).sort_values("date")
    return df.to_dict(orient="records")

sloos = pd.read_parquet(O / "sloos_dashboard.parquet")
panel_bank = records(sloos[sloos["loan_type"] == "C&I - Large"], "survey_date", "net_pct_tightening")

abs_ee = pd.read_parquet(O / "abs_ee_dashboard.parquet")
abs_ee["month"] = pd.to_datetime(abs_ee["filing_date"]).dt.to_period("M").dt.to_timestamp()
abs_ee["d30_cnt"] = abs_ee["d30_rate"] / 100 * abs_ee["loans_with_status"]
grp = abs_ee.groupby("month").agg(d30_cnt=("d30_cnt", "sum"), loans=("loans_with_status", "sum"), n=("d30_cnt", "size")).reset_index()
grp["value"] = 100 * grp["d30_cnt"] / grp["loans"]
retail = grp[(grp["n"] >= 5) & (grp["month"] >= "2018-01-01")]
panel_retail = records(retail, "month", "value")

panel_private = records(pd.read_parquet(O / "private_credit_sample.parquet"), "date", "value")
panel_ai = records(pd.read_parquet(O / "ai_sample.parquet"), "date", "value")

ojs_define(panel_bank=panel_bank, panel_retail=panel_retail, panel_private=panel_private, panel_ai=panel_ai)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
import { Plot } from "npm:@observablehq/plot"

mkSeries = recs => recs.map(d => ({date: new Date(d.date), value: +d.value}))
bank = mkSeries(panel_bank)
retail = mkSeries(panel_retail)
priv = mkSeries(panel_private)
ai = mkSeries(panel_ai)

last = a => a[a.length - 1]
prev = a => a[a.length - 2]
fmt = (v, s = false) => `${s && v > 0 ? "+" : ""}${(+v).toLocaleString(undefined, {maximumFractionDigits: 1})}`
fmtMonth = d => d.toLocaleString("en-US", {month: "short", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC"})
streakUp = a => { let s = 0; for (let i = a.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { if (a[i].value > 0) s++; else break; } return s; }

spark = (data, color, w = 150, h = 26) => Plot.plot({
  width: w, height: h, margin: 1, axis: null, x: {type: "utc"},
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(data, {x: "date", y: "value", fill: color, fillOpacity: 0.10}),
    Plot.lineY(data, {x: "date", y: "value", stroke: color, strokeWidth: 1.2}),
    Plot.dot([last(data)], {x: "date", y: "value", r: 2.4, fill: color})
  ]
})

leadChart = Plot.plot({
  width: 600, height: 236, marginLeft: 32, marginBottom: 22, marginTop: 14, marginRight: 10,
  x: {type: "utc", label: null, ticks: 5, tickFormat: "%Y"},
  y: {label: null, grid: true, tickFormat: d => `${d}%`, ticks: 5},
  style: {fontFamily: "DM Mono, monospace", fontSize: "10px"},
  marks: [
    Plot.rect([{s: new Date("2020-02-01"), e: new Date("2020-05-01")}],
      {x1: "s", x2: "e", y1: -20, y2: 100, fill: "#1C1C1E", fillOpacity: 0.04}),
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#9CA3AF", strokeDasharray: "3,3"}),
    Plot.ruleY([20], {stroke: "#B45309", strokeDasharray: "2,4", strokeOpacity: 0.7}),
    Plot.text([{}], {x: bank[0].date, y: 20, text: ["+20% watch line"], textAnchor: "start", dx: 3, dy: -5, fill: "#B45309", fontSize: 10}),
    Plot.areaY(bank, {x: "date", y: "value", fill: "#4A6FA5", fillOpacity: 0.08}),
    Plot.lineY(bank, {x: "date", y: "value", stroke: "#4A6FA5", strokeWidth: 1.75}),
    Plot.dot([last(bank)], {x: "date", y: "value", r: 3.5, fill: "#4A6FA5"})
  ]
})

retailChart = Plot.plot({
  width: 320, height: 108, marginLeft: 26, marginBottom: 18, marginTop: 6, marginRight: 6,
  x: {type: "utc", label: null, ticks: 4, tickFormat: "%y"},
  y: {label: null, grid: true, ticks: 3, tickFormat: d => `${d}%`},
  style: {fontFamily: "DM Mono, monospace", fontSize: "9px"},
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(retail, {x: "date", y: "value", fill: "#B45309", fillOpacity: 0.08}),
    Plot.lineY(retail, {x: "date", y: "value", stroke: "#B45309", strokeWidth: 1.4}),
    Plot.dot([last(retail)], {x: "date", y: "value", r: 2.8, fill: "#B45309"})
  ]
})
```

//| echo: false
{
  const cur = last(bank), pv = prev(bank), delta = cur.value - pv.value, streak = streakUp(bank);
  const rCur = last(retail).value, pcCur = last(priv).value, aiCur = last(ai).value;
  const asOf = fmtMonth(cur.date);

  const tapeRow = (desk, meta, val, unit, data, color, sample) => html`<div class="tape-row">
    <div class="tape-desk"><span>${desk}</span><span class="${sample ? "smp" : ""}">${meta}</span></div>
    <div class="tape-num">${val}<span class="u">${unit}</span></div>
    <div class="tape-spark">${spark(data, color, 160, 26)}</div>
  </div>`;

  return html`<div>
    <header class="ledger-mast">
      <div class="lm-eyebrow"><span>Credit · Rates · AI — Four Desks</span><span>Vol. I · No. 1</span></div>
      <div class="lm-name">The Field Notes Ledger</div>
      <div class="lm-sub"><span>Rigorous analysis · questionable conclusions</span><span>Readings as of ${asOf}</span></div>
    </header>

    <div class="ledger-body">
      <aside class="col-tape">
        <div class="tape-title">The Tape</div>
        ${tapeRow("Bank Lending", "SLOOS", fmt(cur.value, true) + "%", "", bank, "#4A6FA5", false)}
        ${tapeRow("Retail Credit", "ABS-EE", fmt(rCur) + "%", "", retail, "#B45309", false)}
        ${tapeRow("Private Credit", "SAMPLE", fmt(pcCur) + "%", "", priv, "#7C6FB5", true)}
        ${tapeRow("AI", "SAMPLE", fmt(aiCur) + "%", "", ai, "#3A7D5E", true)}
      </aside>

      <main class="col-lead">
        <div class="lead-kicker">The Bank Lending Desk · SLOOS · Quarterly</div>
        <h2 class="lead-hed">Still Cautious, Just Quieter About It</h2>
        <div class="lead-byline">By the Bank Lending Desk · ${asOf}</div>
        <div class="lead-chart">${leadChart}</div>
        <div class="lead-cap">Net % of banks tightening C&amp;I standards (large & middle-market), 2018–${cur.date.getUTCFullYear()}</div>
        <div class="lead-body">
          <p class="drop">Four times a year the Federal Reserve asks senior loan officers one question worth caring about — are you making it harder or easier to borrow? Net the tighteners against the easers and you get a diffusion index: crude, honest, and one of the few credit signals that leads instead of lags.</p>
          <p>This quarter large-firm C&amp;I printed ${fmt(cur.value, true)}%, ${delta >= 0 ? "up" : "down"} ${Math.abs(delta).toFixed(1)} points from last quarter — ${streak > 1 ? `${streak} straight quarters` : "back"} on the tightening side of zero. Banks being cautious, not scared.</p>
          <div class="pull-stat">
            <div class="ps-num">+20%</div>
            <div class="ps-cap">The line history says precedes trouble. We're sitting at ${fmt(cur.value, true)}.</div>
          </div>
          <p>Cross that line and something in the economy is usually about to break. We are nowhere near it — which is either reassuring or the calm part of the movie, depending on your disposition.</p>
        </div>
        <a class="lead-more" href="/desk/bank-lending/">Open the Bank Lending desk — the full timeline →</a>
      </main>

      <div class="col-side">
        <div class="side-brief">
          <div class="brief-kicker">Retail Credit · ABS-EE · Monthly</div>
          <h3 class="brief-hed">Auto Borrowers, Stretched but Standing</h3>
          <div class="brief-spark">${retailChart}</div>
          <p class="brief-text">Thirty-plus-day delinquency on securitized auto loans reads ${fmt(rCur)}%, pooled across every ABS-EE filer. Elevated and stubbornly flat — the consumer is stretched, not snapping.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="ai-box">
          <div class="brief-kicker">The AI Desk<span class="sample-tag">Sample</span></div>
          <h3 class="brief-hed">The Trough, Measured</h3>
          <div class="brief-spark">${spark(ai, "#3A7D5E", 240, 34)}</div>
          <p class="brief-text">${fmt(aiCur)}% of enterprise AI pilots now show measurable P&amp;L impact, and the line is climbing. If Brynjolfsson is right, this is the boring part of the J-curve — before the payoff. Sample data, for now.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <footer class="ledger-foot">
      <div><strong>Private Credit Desk · Sample.</strong> Direct-lending non-accruals at ${fmt(pcCur)}% and drifting higher. Illustrative placeholder until BDC data lands in the lake.</div>
      <div><strong>Methods.</strong> Bank Lending (SLOOS) and Retail Credit (ABS-EE) are live from the bens-data-lake pipeline. Private Credit and AI are synthetic samples — clearly marked, and not analysis.</div>
    </footer>
  </div>`
}
